key_insight: LLM inference speedups are not portable by default: benefits depend jointly on the technique, runtime, hardware capabilities, and workload.
engineering_relevance: For local Apple Silicon inference, benchmark optimizations under single-request decoding rather than assuming server-GPU gains will transfer.
method: Evaluate KV-cache pruning, speculative decoding, ported GPU kernels, and post-training quantization.
Use a common single-request decode workload across four Apple machines.
Compare with matched RTX 4090 runs where possible.
evidence_signal: KV-cache pruning reached up to 1.75× end-to-end throughput on Apple and transferable kernel components up to 1.20× decode throughput, while all evaluated speculative decoding methods reduced throughput under the common benchmark.
watch_item: Public Metal lacks asynchronous copy, and batch-one decoding makes several serving-oriented mechanisms inapplicable; quantization gains also vary by machine.
paper_title: Evaluating the Applicability of LLM Inference Optimizations on Apple Silicon
